name: KIO-FUSE Pipeline
description: Build, install and verify kio-fuse so KDE apps (dolphin, konsole, kate) can open files that live behind a KIO slave — smb://, sftp://, mtp://, archive:// — as plain paths on disk. Handles both source lines: Qt5/KF5 (kio-fuse 5.x) and Qt6/KF6 (6.x), which do not mix.

panels.title: KIO-FUSE Pipeline
panels.subtitle: Deps, build, install, mount, verify — for the Qt5 and Qt6 lines
